this had my face feeling so soft. there is a smell to it but it doesn't last long

avis.titre: THIS PRODUCT HAS HELPED WITH MY OILY SKIN
avis.texte: 186 / 5.000 , FEEL SO MUCH BETTER AND MY MAKEUP DOESN'T LOOK FLAKY LIKE IT DID BEFORE I USED THE PRODUCT. IT FEELS NICE AND HAS NO FRAGRANCE WHEN YOU APPLY IT.

avis.titre: Amazing product, highly recommend. my favorite!
avis.texte: absolutely wonderful product! I have very sensitive skin and it only occasionally has a mild or minimal redness or sting with it. it does have a heavy alcohol scent but when you see how well this product works none of that will matter to you. not only does it help my EXTREMELY oily skin stay plump but oil free throughout most of the day, it also will help take off any grime or dirt you didn't wash off your face before. I'm going ro be buying this for the foreseeable future. it is my favorite and the best working skin care product I have.
Definitely cleans away excess oil and dirt without drying out my skin.

avis.titre: I do not recommend to use daily
avis.texte: I love the clinique brand and i always go back to the clarifying toner. But unfortunately using it daily twice a day drys my skin out, it causes a burning to my skin. Its just not for me. I have been using this product on and off for years.
this toner is must have product in your skin care routine! it removes all the dead cells and make up and leaves the skin very soft and hydrated!

avis.titre: This is truly the game changer of the skincare line .
avis.texte: Have been using this product since 1980 . It is the difference maker. You can use it with any skincare line if you prefer another and you will most certainly see a difference. If you get a chance ask a Clinique consultant to show you a demo of this product. Seeing is believing.

This does not feel nice nor smell nice. More so it also feels very harsh on the skin. My 4th product that's is a disappointment in the last 12 months. Webchat and phone agents are not helping in terms of service to assist long ter, customers work out why it's not working and suggest an alternative, the self serve model at the price point doesn't work for me. I waste time trying to locate the right product online, make the purchase and get disappointed with the product. I do appreciate the return policy but geez it's a hassle and I've just thrown items out to not waste time returning. Why doesn't anyone at Clinique take the t8me to help a customer that is trying to find suitable alternatives? This is a flaw of cliniques current model for online shoppers.

Ladies & gentlemen...this had ACID in it...a stronger dose of it too...so PLEASE don't just jump in head 1st with this! Take it SLOW, use once every 3 days, after 2 weeks or so, try using once every other day, and go back to every 2 days if need be, figure out what works for YOUR SKIN! Take it slow, or you could cause more damage and chemical burns(the redness & burning and itching some are speaking of). It works, but only works as much as you allow it. Again...SLOWLY, work your way up, some may only ever to use this twice a week and rotate with a gentle toner. GOOD LUCK!
I'm a Clinique user since 15 years but never experienced this with any of their products. Caused huge painful pimples on face and neck. Disappointed :(

I used Clinique in my early 20's and decided to try it again in my late 30's. I remember now why I originally stopped using this. It makes my face seem so oily after a couple hours use. Plus, I've broken out. I had my skin under control before using this product. I will be returning.

I used to use #2 as a teenager when I had instant skin change of acne and it worked within 1 week. As an adult and another surprise skin change (acne and extreme oil production) I started using it again without success. I was recommended to use the #4 twice a day and cannot believe the invisible dirt it removed from my skin after every use. I am more than satisfied as this is the best exfoliant I have ever used.

This straight up felt like I just dabbed that alcohol solution on my face what you use to clean wounds smh … don't know how it has so many good reviews that I didn't even check the ingredients! Be aware
My husband's skin is so oily. Using this fantastic product helps him to sweep away excess oil on his skin. We strongly recommend it to someone who has oily skin.

avis.titre: I would buy this product again
avis.texte: This product is great for acne-prone and oily skin. It helps remove residual makeup that the makeup removes missed as well.
I've been using this product for many years. It sloughs off the dead skin after cleansing and leaves my skin bright and ready for moisturizer.
I've been using this since my mum bought it when i was twelve, now i can't stop. it actually helps if you have oily skin and frequent break outs. its definitely my favorite thing in the web.

avis.titre: I would buy this again and again!
avis.texte: I have been a Clinique girl since I was 20 years old, I'm in my early 40's now, and I still use them! This is a go to for my very oily skin. It really cleans it after a day of makeup, dirt, sweat, oil. Very refreshing. Follow the rest of the usual three step Clinique system!

avis.titre: Wouldn't recommend for those with sensitive skin
avis.texte: I had already left a review after trying this for a couple of days and I really like how it makes my skin feel after using it. It leaves me soft and very clean. I just cannot get past the smell. It literally burns my eyes and I hold my breath to use it. I've now discovered that it's burning my skin as well, and I know this is what's causing it because my skin only gets raspy after using this product. I didn't get this reaction at first but now that i've been consistently using this in my routine i notice the red itchy hive like bumps on my face for hours. My face has always been SO sensitive, so i'm sure this is a factor too.

I've included this product in my skin care routine and so far I like it a lot. It leaves me feeling clean and soft. However.. the smell. I've never put something that smells so strong on my face. I literally hold my breath to use this and breathe through my mouth.
This works! Especially for us very oily individuals. I truly saw the difference in my skin when i switch from toner 3 to this one. It made all the difference. Skin now clear.

I have sensitive oily skin that breaks out occasionally and this exfoliating lotion works wonderfully. It doesn't irritate my skin or break me out. I tried number 3 but it wasn't strong enough for my t zone. The Acne Solutions exfoliating lotion was too strong. Highly recommend this!

The best cleansing toner I've ever used! Even after washing with a cleanser this toner still finds the dirt per my cotton balls. Great for oily/normal skin. This is a staple in my skin care. Especially during summer!

avis.titre: Keeps the dead skin cells away
avis.texte: I have been using Clinique for so long that they didn't have any of the "Turn around" products. I started out using Lotion #2, way back when. As the years passed I found out from my consultant that I could step up to a stronger Clarifying lotion and over the years I made my way to #4. I have fine pored pale skin but I do not have any redness or irritation but I did have to step my way up over a few years. Worth every second to increase the exfoliation. I still use #4 and occasionally use one of the Turn around products to switch things every so often. I bet that if you just saw my facial complexion you would never guess just how old I am.

I absolutely love this, your skin feels Soo clean afterwards and makes your skin glow ! I could wash my face 3 times, and this product will still pull more dirt, it's insane! I use this twice/day-morning & night & I have seen major improvement. You must try!
I'm excited using this product, it helps exfoliating and removing dead skin exactly for oily skins.

avis.titre: I have used this product for years
avis.texte: I have used this product for years approx 27.. I've tried other brands but nothing compares.

avis.titre: Love the way my skin feels
avis.texte: I use this twice a day, it makes my skin feel so clean and fresh, without drying it. I would recommend this to anyone who wants clean and fresh skin.
I've used this toner for years. Skin feels really clean afterword. Not too drying like some oily skin toners
first day of using it. no comment yet on how the product is working on my skin but what's with the strong smell? if you are sensitive to smells i wouldn't recommend.

avis.titre: Cleanser that works for my skin.

I was skeptical. But i loved it! Now its a must have! Leaves my skin feeling refreshed and super clean. Even after washing my face it always removes any dirt or makeup left behind!

avis.titre: Not good for me. But it's for oily skin

Ive been using this for 3 to 4 months now as part of my 3 step system. I love it because it has removed all of the dirt from clogged pores, its really smoothed out my face, and has helped my face to be a lot less oily. Honestly, my face has never been this clean. I will continue to use this twice a day.

avis.titre: It can be your best mate
avis.texte: I love this exfoliator lotion, I've been using it for about 10 years. It can be your best mate if you choose the right one for your skin type.

I wanted to love this product since I have very oily skin. When applied it burns my skin and leaves it red and feels as if it has sucked all the moisture out. My skin no doubt felt clean but not healthy. I believe it it the high alcohol content that my skin did not love unfortunately.

I have used this product for over forty years and love that it still works for me. Although I am in my sixties, I still get skin breakouts from time to time. When this happens, I take a Q-Tip and run very warm water over one end for a minute, then apply it to the blemish for about 30 seconds. Then I saturate the other end of the Q-Tip with Clarifying Lotion and after drying the blemish, I apply the end with Clarifying Lotion to the blemish for 15 seconds. For stubborn blemishes, I do this several times. It has never failed me yet!
I use it daily on the oily parts of my face and sometimes all over my face, like in the summer time or after workouts. It keeps my skin clean and the pores minimized.

I used this only once and had to stop using it as this toner stung. My skin isn't even that sensitive but somehow reacted badly to this. Oily skin benefits from hydration anyway, stripping it off oil via alcohol (as in this product) only results in more oil production. Will try an alcohol-free toner next.

I have combination skin but is super oily tea zone. This really cuts grease! Works amazingly with or without make up. It is a must have! Really helped with preventing breakouts even during my menstrual cycle. I LOVE THUS PRODUCT!

avis.titre: Love this great for oily skin
avis.texte: I have sensitive oily acne prone skin. I have been suffering from Tony white heads all over my mouth and twine area. I was using the ordinary toner and when it became sold out i figured let me just try a Clinique one since i used there moisturizer. I'm so happy i tired it . My skin has been less oily throughout the day and my white heads are gone . Have been using for little over a week. I have tried the toner that comes with acne Clinique kit and that didn't work as well for me. So Iwould say if your struggling with white heads try this !

avis.titre: Great for my skin, but strong alcohol smell
avis.texte: It's a great product that definitely does what it sets out to do. The only downside is there's a strong smell of alcohol that comes along with it, but I can get over that. Definitely helps my oily skin.

Over the summer my skin was really textured. I'm not sure what was going on but it was causing my makeup to just look horrible. I purchased the 3 step system and have been using it for the past 3 weeks and my skin is perfection! While it has done nothing to keep the oil at bay, it really has retextured my skin. Very happy with the results.

avis.titre: I get this mounthly it's perfect for oily skin
avis.texte: I have oily skin and this makes it disappear. Which then also helps with acne problems I use daily.

I use this twice a day and I can tell that it helps to exfoliate and cut back on the oiliness. I have some adult acne and very oily skin, however this with the acne solutions face bar, I can really tell a difference! It is worth it!

avis.titre: Excellent product to make skin smoother & unclog pores.
avis.texte: I worked in cosmetics over 20 years ago when I discovered this and saw that makeup goes on better & skin looks looks more vibrant for all who used it.

Recently I learned from several medical sources that Alcohol denat is one of the worst alcohol compounds in skin care. Other types of alcohol are safe. The kind in all of cliniques toners or clarifying lotions have the dangerous kind that will irritate capillaries and delay regeneration of skin. I hope clinique changes their toners soon!
I am using this product since last 1 year and works really well for my oily skin. It cleans dead cells and very well. A must use before applying the moisturiser
I have been using this toner for years. It's a staple in my facial regime. It has complimented every cleanser I've tried.

I bought this to control oily skin based on reviews and my own product search. I did not use it as part of a Clinique regimen. This smells like malt alcohol and is very drying for my oily/combination skin. Hard for me to keep trying to use it to see if the oil goes down because it smells so bad to me.

avis.titre: I'm going to purchase this product, again.
avis.texte: If you have oily skin then I highly recommend this product and the other two products that should be used with this product.
I am obsessed with the 3 step system and the clarifying lotion is my favorite part. I cannot go a day without it! It exfoliates and makes my face feel refreshed and ready for the day.

avis.titre: Just pour alcohol on your face
avis.texte: This kills me that it's called "clarifying LOTION." I can't believe I used this for so long and trusted Clinique because it was a prestigious brand and "allergy tested." This stuff is essentially denatured alcohol (read the ingredient list) that dries out the skin to make you think it's getting rid of your oiliness and it contains multiple dyes. (Allergy tested?!) I've since switched to an alcohol free/dye free, all natural toner and my skin feels amazing and healthy. Don't let Clinique fool you!
I am using this product for a month .cleanes and exfoliates my skin nicely .why I put 4 star means it has alcohol smell and when apply on the face it irritate my eyes that's why.

Really great at removing excess dirt, grime, oil, etc. Feels fresh and not drying, which I love, as other exfoliators have left my skin SUPER dried out. Amazing at prepping my skin before I apply moisturizer!
It is amazing that even after cleaning my face, I can still see some brown/dark debris on the cotton ball, which I used to wipe my face. Does it mean that our cleanser is not clean enough?

avis.titre: Doesn't irritate and let's my skin breath
avis.texte: My skin is finally able to really breathe after the skin clarifying routine. This exfoliator is gentle to the skin but really removes excess oils or dead skin cells from the epidermis. Redness from acne and skin marks have become less visible with time. Precious product. I will definitely reorder
It does the job in removing any remaining dirt after cleansing your faith and it does not leave that dry feeling. It is a wonderful product. It really works well on my oily skin.

I had to stop using this product...my skin quickly became irritated and blotchy red. Perhaps it's just too strong for my particular skin type, plus, I'm older and skin thins with age. For potential users, pay attention to skin type when purchasing. Normally, I'm very pleased with Clinique products!

I started using the 3 step skin care about 8 months ago. Initially I bought the kit that had the number 3 toner for combination oily skin. It worked well but after using that up, I decided to step it up and use this number 4 for oily skin. It really helps with oil control and keeps my face feeling fresh and not shiny.

My skin was extremely oily, so every Clinique calculator that I tried told me that this was the clarifying lotion that I had to use. I tried it, but it burned. I had to go to #3 (which is for combination/oily skin). The Clinique sales person told me that if anyone has extremely oily skin that they should use #3 to get used to it before moving up to #4. This worked well at removing makeup and oil, though.

I have been using Clinique Clarifying Lotion 4 for years!!! I have tried many other high end products and keep coming back to this one. Have not found a toner that makes my skin feel as clean and removes the oils as well as this !
I have been using this since I was a teenager. I would recommend clinique face care to anyone, especially those who have sensitive skin.

This toner works wonders. Yes there are lots of other brands out there, but Clinique has had a long lasting tenure in the beauty business. And their products just keep getting better and better. Try ANYTHING from Clinique and you'll never be disappointed!

avis.titre: This is perfection and also stops my breakouts!
avis.texte: I use this twice a day. It definitely helps with oils all day long I don't get half as oily anymore, I already see improvement on blemishes and clears away all makeup and dirt after washing face that's left behind.
I've been using this product for 3 years. My face is crazy oily. The wash, with #4, and the gel moisturizer has kept my face beautiful. Compliments all the time. Thank you Clinique!

I bought this one cause my skin gets oily in the winter time ( I was using #3). My skin is no longer oily, now it does dry out my skin after I use it but once I put on the moisturizing lotion, that fixes that issue.

avis.titre: Love the clarifying lotion - Ulta, not so much

Being someone who has suffered from acne for most of her life, the products from Clinique were always highly recommended by my dermatologist and have yet to let me down.

avis.titre: Removes all the oil off my face
avis.texte: I love this product! It removes all the oil of my face and doesn't dry it out. Foundation goes on well and stays on my face all day without shine.
I was hoping they reformulated it to have less alcohol but clearly, that's not the case. I have oily skin & this is too much for me even in the SUMMER.
Leaves my skin clear and soft, really works great, I totally recommend this product.

I wish I had a before picture to share, but my daughter had a horrible/ugly pimple that was just not responding to any treatment! With just one application, that pimple started clearing up! By the next morning, it was already clearing! It also started clearing some other potential problem areas!! Love this product!
Love this toner! Have been purchasing for years and really love the way my skin feels after I use it - very, very clean and nice! Clinique is a good value for the money, and it does what it promises.

I have struggled with acne and oily prone skin my entire life. As a 24 year old I have been trying for years and years to find something to help my skin. I have finally found that product. Honestly, this toner is one of the best toners I have ever used. My skin has never looked better since using this and the Clinique dramatically different moisturizing lotion. But seriously, as soon as I put this toner on I can feel my face thanking me as my skin immediately starts to glow and have a dewy look.

This has helped me over the years from when my acne was cystic and painful to now when it just keeptsbit clear and glowing. I used to have terrible acne and this helped me so much. Now post acne medicine I use it to keep my skin fresh looking and glowing healthy.
I love this product. It works great on oily skin but isn't overly drying.

I bought this toner almost a year ago. I've purchased some drug store toners and they can be harsh. So my expectations weren't too high for this one. My skin is oily and sometimes sensitive so they can dry me out. But this one wasn't too harsh on my skin. I do see a difference when I use it, my skin appears to be smoother and doesn't turn my face into a desert.
Use twice a day. Very good product. Balances my oily skin very well.
I tried using cheaper skin care prroducts as i get older I realized I needed to spend a little more money to take care of my skin..

avis.titre: The stuff this takes off my skin is crazy amazing
avis.texte: I recieved this as a free sample and was blown away. I will be purchasing this. The first time I used it I couldn't believe what was on my cotton ball. I had washed my face before trying this and was in shock of all the discoloration that was on that cotton ball. Since then I've been using this morning and night and I can feel the difference. My makeup seems to be staying on my face longer throughout the day. And my skin is looking smoother.

I had oily skin for most of my life. I used this occasionally in addition to the Lotion #2. I noticed a beige color on the cotton ball ... it was actually taking off dead skin cells. Then I broke a bone and had to be in a cast for a month. The nasty post-cast skin came right off with this! I used a white washcloth so I could see how much came off. I was shocked and should have kept a picture. Moms of boys? Are you listening?
With this product I can feel the difference right away, I have very oily skin and using this product I have more control on that.
I've been using this clarifying lotion along with the soap for oily skin and DDMG and I could not be happier. Also, the 3 step system prevents acne.

I recently decided that I needed to step up my game in terms of skincare; I can't really get away with basic cleansing with soap and using generic moisturizer anymore. I have heard so many amazing things about Clinique, so I decided to try the Clinique 3-step system in oily. The 3-step has the usual cleanse and moisturize, but adding the Clarifying Lotion takes skincare to the next level. This is a miracle-worker. It controls oil, exfoliates, and leaves my skin feeling super soft and smooth but not dry at all. I've been using it for two weeks and I can already see an amazing difference in how my skin looks. Two weeks ago, I would wash/moisturize in the morning and by 11:00 am, my skin would be slick and oily, and already have eaten all my makeup--not any more. This will definitely be part of my skincare routine for many years!

I usually use Clinique level 3 toner but my skin is still very oily so I thought I would try level 4. Only after a couple of uses it dried my skin out and sucked all the life out of it. I returned this product. I think this would be a good buy for those with extremely oily skin and skin that is not sensitive.
